limitations: Public corpus with no protected holdout (L7-EVAL-007 is unmet): the hidden checks are readable on this machine and to Level 7's implementer, so results are formative and cannot support a release claim.
Eight small stdlib-only Python tasks; results may not transfer to larger, multi-language, or long-running work.
Twenty-four pairs detect only large differences; an INCONCLUSIVE claim is not evidence of equivalence.
Both arms receive the same task text, model, effort, and sandbox; the plain arm lacks Level 7's worker rules as well as its process, so prompt and process effects are not separated.
Codex only, on the route Level 7 picks for its first implementer; another model or provider may differ.
Token counts come from Codex's own usage events through the meter; trials without complete usage events are reported as unmeasured.
